headline: Nigeria's Dangote Refinery Closes Public Offering
summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery has closed its public offer, bringing its downstream operations to public investors amid ongoing questions regarding shareholder returns and energy security.
why: Dangote Refinery is Africa's largest oil processing facility, playing a critical role in reducing Nigeria's dependence on imported refined fuel and shaping regional energy markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Completion of the refinery IPO supports domestic refining capacity and crude self-sufficiency.
